minimum_speakers_not_inferred: Report exact strict available N; include all eligible when N<12. Do not widen duration or switch split silently.
duration_metadata: (original uncompressed WAV member bytes -44)/32000 is only an estimate. Actual 16kHz PCM16 mono header duration must be within [8,9] before any model call.
speaker_selection: Fixed PRNG sample without replacement from sorted eligible unused speakers; select min(12,N). All N used when N<12.
utterance_selection: One fixed PRNG index in each sorted complete-member pool. Freeze full cyclic same-speaker technical-header fallback order before WAV/reference/model reads.
technical_fallback: Transport/CRC errors retry exact same member or stop. Only after exact original CRC: invalid format/header or actual duration outside [8,9] permits next frozen same-speaker member. If none valid, STOP; any smaller N requires Root to freeze a new evidenced plan before model calls, never silent shrink or model/ref selection.
independence_claim: Experimental-history speaker/utterance/audio separation only; not pretrained-model-unseen speech. Speaker count differs from clip/repeat/run counts.
other_split_policy: Inspect and report only. Any change from this provided test namespace requires a separately frozen design and separate result stratum.
